item.tib: brag btsan dmar po'i bskang ba
brag btsan dmar po'i bskang ba
item.coloph: kho bo g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bdag rig 'dzin gong ma'i sgrub gnas maN+Dal ri khrod du ge khod bsnyen bsgrub skabs su shing sbrul zla 3 tshes 23 gyi nub mor yid tsam gnas de'i mkha' spyod tshogs gral du phyin snang / zhing khams de yi byang shar bse mkhar nang nas brag btsan gyis dngos grub tu bab pa 'od kyi gang bu thig le sngo mthing ser ljang dmar ba'i rnam pa bcu shar ba'i nang / thig le dmar po gru bzhi nang brag btsan bskang (skong) ba 'di zla tshes nyi shar brda' yig shog ser du phab pa'o//
